content: PARTIAL: break-room function reads, but nine visible lockers are short of the requested ten; seat capacity is not verified

geometry.visual_footprint_verdict: UNVERIFIED; image impression is near-square and does not prove the required 4:3 tile rectangle

notes: The room and kitchenette are recognizable; the large staff-room fixture type is distinct from the existing S/M candidates.
Visual inspection shows nine locker doors, fewer than the requested ten; seating count/capacity is not independently verified.
Room floor looks close to square in the image; the required 4x3 tile ratio is not demonstrated. Do not resize/warp to force the fixture dimensions.
The glossy, rendered finish and dark vignette do not match the target game style.
At alpha thresholds 1, 8, and 128, the silhouette fails the 12% padding target on every edge; low-alpha haze surrounds the content.
Projection slopes, exact 4x3 ground polygon, 2.4m height, south access clearance, anchor and Godot display remain unverified.
Original PNG is retained byte-for-byte; no crop, scale, or alpha cleanup was applied.
